描述_EN: the coat is available in two styles which follow the classic male (lucien) and female (victoire) trench coat silhouettes. the disadvantage of polyester is that it sheds microplastic when washed. to try to counterbalance this issue, filippa k promotes the use of the guppy friend washing bag. the eternal trench coat was designed in line with the principles of slow fashion, which aims to reduce consumption by manufacturing high-quality, long-lasting products. made from durable and hard-wearing polyester produced from recycled plastic bottles, the coat is designed to last for at least a decade and can be completely recycled when worn out. this reduces the number of microplastic fibres which are shed from friction during washing and prevents them from being released directly into the water system. this versatility in use is a key part of their design, intended to help reduce the overconsumption of clothing. only made in black, the coats are waterproof and lightweight and designed to be worn with layers to enable them to be suitable in both mild and cold weather.
描述_ZN: 该大衣有两种款式，分别是经典的男式（Lucien）和女式（Victoire）风衣的轮廓。 聚酯的缺点是它在洗涤时脱落了微塑料。 为了尝试平衡这个问题，Filippa K推广使用Guppy friend洗涤袋。 永恒的风衣是按照慢时尚的原则设计的，其目的是通过制造高质量、持久的产品来减少消耗。 由回收的塑料瓶生产的耐用和耐磨的聚酯制成，该大衣的设计至少可以使用十年，并且在穿坏后可以完全回收。 这减少了洗涤过程中因摩擦而脱落的微塑料纤维的数量，并防止它们直接释放到水系统中。 这种使用的多样性是其设计的一个关键部分，旨在帮助减少服装的过度消费。 只有黑色，大衣是防水和轻量级的，设计成可以穿多层，使其在温和和寒冷的天气都适用。
